description: This PHP source file belongs to the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically within the admin controller for managing 'topics' in the CMS module. It defines the class 'Topic' with methods for listing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, and deleting topics, supporting localization, SEO, layouts, and store filtering.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Controller class for managing CMS topics within the OpenCart admin panel, providing CRUD operations, status toggling, and data management for topics, including localization and SEO features.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of topics with filters and links to actions.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to list topics, outputs the list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates data and HTML for listing topics, including pagination and sorting.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a topic, with data pre-filled if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing topic, including validation and SEO URL management.
